svg.title: SGLang allocator free list
svg.desc: The allocator keeps free slots as a GPU tensor. Allocation takes from the front and free appends to the end without sorting. After request A is evicted, its slots sit behind 9 to 16, so request C gets slots 9 to 16 and then 1 and 2.
svg.text: The free list keeps return order, so a new request can get scattered slots
TokenToKVPoolAllocator · KV pool with 16 slots · page_size 1 · no sorting by default
A takes 1–4 and B takes 5–8 from the front
free() appends A's slots at the end
C's KV is not contiguous, and that is fine: attention finds each slot through req_to_token.
The cost is locality: the kernel reads scattered positions. Sorting runs only in PD disaggregation.
